detail.longDescription: Building has become easier than ever before, but getting human attention hasn’t. Existing platforms reward attracting attention, rather than giving it. Voom is built on a different premise: feedback for feedback. You earn a stamp each time a maker accepts your feedback. Two stamps let you request feedback on your own project. Through MCP, an agent can submit a project, specify what it wants a person to evaluate, and receive human feedback it can act on. Voom is available through ChatGPT, Claude, or directly at voom.ink.
